Vendored from `@wolffo/three-fire@1.4.0` (dist/vanilla.esm.js), MIT — https://github.com/typeWolffo/THREE.Fire
Volumetric ray-marched fire (GLSL, WebGLRenderer). The package also ships a TSL/WebGPU build (`/tsl/vanilla`) for
the Sandbox Studio port. Texture: `assets/fx/fire.png` (the repo's `src/Fire.png`). Only import: `three`.
